# Grid-connection model (B4)

*Generated by `pixi run grid-model` (rtl.demand.grid_connection). Status: draft.*

**Question.** What is the probability that a household in a given place is connected to the grid?
**Label.** DHS 2025, `hv206` "has electricity", 14,427 households in 560 clusters
(weighted national share 55%). Cluster points are displaced (urban ≤ 2 km,
rural ≤ 5 km), so features are building-weighted means over H3 r8 rings of that size (k = {'urban': 2, 'rural': 5}), and
each building receives its neighbourhood's probability. The model cannot tell two neighbouring buildings apart.
**Features.** log_dist_mv, log_dist_road_major, log_dist_road_any, log_pop_density, rwi, urban_ghsl, nres_share, log_footprint, large_share, log_poi_250m, elevation_km, cropland, log_bldg_density. No DHS variable is an input.
**Model used for predictions:** logistic (lowest held-out log loss).

## Held-out performance (grouped 5-fold cross-validation by district)

| model | scope | clusters | auc | brier | log_loss | cluster_mae | cluster_r2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| national_rate | all | 560 | 0.421 | 0.250 | 0.693 | 0.289 | -0.026 |
| national_rate | urban | 198 | 0.434 | 0.219 | 0.630 | 0.352 | -3.261 |
| national_rate | rural | 362 | 0.481 | 0.263 | 0.720 | 0.262 | -0.247 |
| urban_rural_rate | all | 560 | 0.676 | 0.204 | 0.592 | 0.215 | 0.388 |
| urban_rural_rate | urban | 198 | 0.419 | 0.112 | 0.385 | 0.137 | -0.018 |
| urban_rural_rate | rural | 362 | 0.471 | 0.244 | 0.680 | 0.248 | -0.005 |
| logistic | all | 560 | 0.752 | 0.197 | 0.569 | 0.194 | 0.453 |
| logistic | urban | 198 | 0.768 | 0.106 | 0.342 | 0.110 | 0.169 |
| logistic | rural | 362 | 0.614 | 0.236 | 0.666 | 0.230 | 0.087 |
| gradient_boosting | all | 560 | 0.737 | 0.206 | 0.593 | 0.202 | 0.376 |
| gradient_boosting | urban | 198 | 0.749 | 0.110 | 0.354 | 0.115 | 0.061 |
| gradient_boosting | rural | 362 | 0.592 | 0.247 | 0.695 | 0.239 | -0.043 |
| oracle_cluster_share | all | 560 | 0.885 | 0.137 | 0.409 | 0.000 | 1.000 |
| oracle_cluster_share | urban | 198 | 0.882 | 0.079 | 0.251 | 0.000 | 1.000 |
| oracle_cluster_share | rural | 362 | 0.838 | 0.162 | 0.476 | 0.000 | 1.000 |

AUC and Brier are household-weighted; cluster MAE and R² compare the predicted and observed share per cluster.
`oracle_cluster_share` uses each cluster's own observed share: the ceiling for any model that, like this one, can
only tell neighbourhoods apart (households in one cluster share their features).

## What drives it

Permutation importance (rise in log loss when a feature is shuffled):

| feature | importance |
|---|---|
| log_pop_density | 0.084 |
| rwi | 0.011 |
| large_share | 0.008 |
| log_dist_mv | 0.006 |
| log_bldg_density | 0.005 |
| urban_ghsl | 0.003 |
| nres_share | 0.003 |
| log_poi_250m | 0.002 |

## Figures
- `reports/figures/B4_grid_raw_features.png`: the raw features, per H3 r7 cell
- `reports/figures/B4_grid_label.png`: the label, its district pattern and its link to distance to the MV line
- `reports/figures/B4_grid_model.png`: calibration, cluster fit and importance
- `reports/figures/B4_grid_predictions.png`: national predictions and the district check

## Limits
- Displacement blurs the label: building-level differences within ~2-5 km are not learnt.
- Distance to the MV line is Gridfinder's prediction, itself built from night lights and roads.
- "Has electricity" includes a few solar home systems and mini-grids; it is a connection proxy, not a meter.
- Predictions are for households; non-residential buildings get the same neighbourhood value.
